schema_and_adversarial_layers.object: oracle and review schemas plus layered adversarial guards
schema_and_adversarial_layers.independent_check: Draft202012Validator.check_schema reports both metaschemas valid; all 19 current contract instances and immutable v1 failed receipt validate. Direct mutations reject invalid fact keys, locked-null revisions, and pass receipts containing did_not_work checks. Dangling paths, extra keyed universes, snapshots, duplicate relation IDs, counts, cursors, and partitions are accepted by JSON Schema but each is rejected by an independent cross-integrity replay, preserving the schema/cross-document boundary.

fixture_truth_replay.object: Python, TypeScript, and JavaScript fixture truth
fixture_truth_replay.independent_check: Canonical LF plus final LF reconstruction validates 27 fixture files and all 62 expected facts: every file content hash and every fact span text, offset, line, and column recompute. The frozen sets include indexed, excluded, parse_error, unsupported states; scope-qualified same-name symbols; alias/relative/absolute/type-only/dynamic/wildcard import/export cases; resolved, ambiguous, unresolved, external, and unsupported outcomes; and Unicode paths/content.

mutation_controls.object: replace, corrupt-span, and force-unsupported mutation controls
mutation_controls.independent_check: All nine controls locate their old_text exactly once and replacement byte deltas are correct for the three replace controls. HIGH defect: py.replace_call changes pkg/api.py at byte 239 from 22 bytes to 17 (declared -5), but unchanged py.call.dynamic remains at byte 280; the mutated source has the expected text at byte 275 and byte 280 slices b'eturn obj.run()\n'. The three corrupt_span controls also keep byte-identical old_text/new_text while declaring line_delta=1 and byte_delta=1, with no created corrupted span, so their mutation cannot be uniquely reconstructed from source plus receipt.

task_lock_cross_integrity.object: real lock and downstream task contract
task_lock_cross_integrity.independent_check: All nine task snapshots match their lock URL, commit, tree, and source_root_trees; every relation status count, evidence-id set, positive-budget cursor chain, interruption outcome, and universe partition recomputes for the nine baseline tasks. Fresh adversarial mutations of snapshot repo, relation IDs/counts, cursors, and universe states are rejected by the independent semantic replay.

primary_git_replay.object: locked primary Git revisions and downstream spans
primary_git_replay.independent_check: For each of the nine locked repositories, a fresh temporary bare repository fetched the exact URL and commit with git fetch --depth=1 --filter=blob:none; rev-parse reproduced the locked commit, whole tree, and each bounded source-root tree. git cat-file blob independently matched all 25 downstream task span texts, SHA-256 values, line/column coordinates, and root containment, including all six Nest facts.

role_and_state_boundary.independent_check: The current lock has nine required locked repositories, including the reachable Nest TypeScript replacement, and four explicitly cannot_judge extension candidates with null revisions and empty roots. No floating commit/tree or dangling task snapshot remains. The SQLite role is intentionally an unsupported-language failure boundary; this review does not promote an adapter or claim core implementation success.

p1a_dispatch_gate.independent_check: The fixture content, schema, task, lock, and primary-Git layers are independently reproducible, but the HIGH mutation defect means expected mutation truth is not consumable without inventing offset-rewrite behavior. P3/P4 adapter dispatch therefore remains blocked; this receipt makes no adapter-success or core-promotion claim.

counterexample_or_residual: Independent v2 review fails P1A. Baseline fixture hashes/spans, lock/task cross-integrity, and fresh primary-Git replay pass, but py.replace_call shortens pkg/api.py by five bytes at offset 239 while leaving py.call.dynamic at stale offset 280 (the correct mutated offset is 275); its unchanged-fact span cannot be consumed. corrupt_span controls additionally declare nonzero span deltas without changing source bytes or freezing a unique corrupted span. The fixture contract is not dispatch-ready, so P3/P4 remain blocked. Nine locked real roles and four explicit cannot_judge extension candidates are a separate readiness boundary; this is not an adapter or core-promotion claim.
